card.name: Words just before a toilet or airway term
card.fires_on: Linking words (using, the, and, comma) right before a likely next word such as toilet, bathroom, or airway. Seen in overdose supportive-care lists and hygiene advice.

modes.label: Before toilet or bathroom
modes.description: A small word after going to or using, where bathroom or toilet comes next.
modes.example: especially after going to<< the>> bathroom, touching animals

modes.label: Overdose supportive measures
modes.description: The word 'and' or a comma after intravenous fluids, in a list of general supportive care.
modes.example: including intravenous fluids<< and>> airway management. Flumazenil
